multi_entity_note: Two companies in different roles (Cremer Oleo GmbH & Co KG as supplier and Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc as buyer) with separate addresses.
processing_note: Payments shall be made by Ultragenyx in Euro and within [***] days after receipt of a proper invoice.

contract.document_name.rationale: The document is headed SUPPLY AGREEMENT.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The agreement becomes effective on its execution date, and the only execution date given is Hamburg, November 19th, 2012; 'the date of its execution' is not itself a date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term is three years from execution; no expiration date is stated as a date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Article 9(1) applies the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany; other 'Germany' mentions are an address and the place of jurisdiction.
